about.title: The archer who hits the mark.
paragraphs: In ancient Turkic mythology, Mergen is the god of wisdom: the archer who never misses. We bring that precision to our work. Listen well first, then build with aim.
Our logo says it too: a prompt waiting for your question (>), and a point that hits home (.).

Mergen Tech is run by Serdar Aydemir. He worked as a civil servant in both Türkiye and the Netherlands, studied history, and now builds participation software at a Dutch municipality. He knows the public sector from the inside.
